_note: CUST-HV V9d-4 — commerce firewall (V0 §14.3). A hostile document: every scope the production normalizer accepts (document tokens, branding, header, footer, contact, whatsapp, social, verification, sbc, apps, navigation, pagePresentation, announcements, palette, homepage sections, section content, section design, design.cards, nested items) carries commercial keys (price, discount, stock, availability, tax, total, currency, sku, quantity, shipping fee / amount, freight, delivery fee, offer status, coupon code, cost). After normalisation NO such key may survive anywhere, and no injected value may be reachable. Shared by PHP StorefrontPresentationNormalizer and both TS twins (normalizePresentationConfig). Deny rule (shared by the PHP and both TS suites): split a key into words (camelCase / snake_case / kebab-case, lower-cased); the key is DENIED when any word is in `commerceWords` and the LAST word is not in `presentationSuffixes`. So value-bearing and scaling / hiding controls (price, unitPrice, taxAmount, priceMultiplier, discountScale, hideStock, availabilityVisible, showPrice, offerStatus…) are denied, while position / colour-role / size-step / shape / placement controls over real data (pricePosition, stockTextSize, availabilityBadgePlacement…) and the id selectors (offerIds, productIds) are allowed. `allowedKeys` must never be denied; `deniedKeys` must always be.
